name: Vekoa
source:
Vekoa is a jut qou obesk who acted as the groundsmind for The Embassy. She resided on the groundsmindry floor, which was near the bottom of the spire. She was able to be contacted by Obesk in the Embassy through Attendants. 

[spoiler]Her sprite in-game is a spoiler.[/spoiler]

[Based on [url=https://corru.wiki/wiki/Vekoa]Corru Observer Wiki[/url]]
